hypotheses.thesis: Real activity (congress net-buy, lobbying ramp, 8-k material events) on AIT, FAST, FERG, GGG… is accelerating (~1.5× YoY) while the theme's 60-day relative strength sits at -3%. Activity ahead of price — watch.

hypotheses.thesis: Real activity (gov contracts (quiver), congress net-buy, lobbying ramp) on AJG, AXP, BLK, COIN… is accelerating (~1.3× YoY) while the theme's 60-day relative strength sits at +3%. Activity ahead of price — watch.

caveats: Multi-source real-activity proxy (federal + Quiver gov-contracts/congress/lobbying + modeled news velocity). Coverage varies by theme; absent sources are down-weighted, not faked.
Activity data is lagged and the cross-section is small, so the z-scores are rough. Display-only context — not a trade signal.
